name: MOSS-Image (Base and SFT)

lineage.base_model: OpenMOSS-Team/MOSS-Image-Base (SFT is a supervised fine-tune of it with the same architecture and pipeline)
lineage.how_derived: 5B single-stream DiT pretrained from scratch (technical report); SFT variant fine-tuned for clearer text grouping and layouts (card)

purpose: Open-weight text-to-image system for dense, long-form bilingual (English and Chinese) text rendering and precise layout control, with an agentic prompt-enhancement module that turns requests into content and layout specifications (arXiv abstract).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: LICENSE file of the SFT repo read: Apache License 2.0; card states weights and bundled inference code are Apache-2.0.

architecture.kind: single-stream diffusion transformer (MOSSImageTransformer, flow-matching Euler) with a Qwen3.5 text encoder (Qwen3_5Model) and the FLUX.2 VAE (AutoencoderKLFlux2)
architecture.why_this_design: Technical report abstract: the from-scratch 5B single-stream DiT with its training recipe is meant to enable bilingual long-form text rendering and precise layout control; the card adds negative-branch layer skipping (layer 22) to guide with fewer forwards.

variants.format: diffusers BF16 (DiT 5.08B parameters plus Qwen3.5 text encoder and VAE)

variants.notes: Q8_0 5.48 GB, UD-Q6_K_XL 4.53 GB, BF16 10.17 GB; text encoder separate; 264k downloads on the HF API

pc-12gb.variant: GGUF Q4_K_M to Q8_0 with text encoder offloaded

engine_support.notes: Default sampling is 50 steps, CFG 3, shift 5, with negative branch layer skipping; two transformer forwards per step.

benchmarks.name: LongLongTextBench (LLTB) average text coverage, long-form English and Chinese text rendering
benchmarks.variant: MOSS-Image system, best among open-weight models per the builder
benchmarks.harness: benchmark introduced by the same authors

benchmarks.name: RealLayoutArena (RLA) end-to-end system rank
benchmarks.variant: MOSS-Image with prompt enhancement; the backbone ranks 1st among generators with shared enhanced prompts
benchmarks.harness: benchmark introduced by the same authors

strengths: Long text and layout control through JSON layouts with bounding boxes
5B DiT with GGUF Q4_K_M of 3.2 GB
weaknesses: Benchmarks are the builder's own new benchmarks (LLTB, RLA)
German text rendering not stated: bilingual English and Chinese only
Prompt enhancer skill is designed for GPT-6-family agents (card)
best_for: posters, signs and infographics with dense text and layouts; layout-controlled generation
soft.maturity: OpenMOSS (Fudan/MOSI); many community derivatives on the HF API (Base 12k and SFT 20k downloads, ComfyUI plugin).

tona_fit.reason: 5B size and layout control make it a strong option for local image generation; German text rendering and general image quality versus z-image-turbo, qwen-image-2.1-turbo and flux3-image-klein need our own test.
blockers: MOSS DiT with Qwen3.5 text encoder and FLUX.2 VAE not in Tona

open_questions: Difference in quality between Base and SFT
German and other European text rendering
Distillation or few-step variants (community LoRAs exist, not inspected)
